units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 24:12">Kel. XXIV, 12</cite> <he>העשוי לש׳</he> a hide used as a rug (to sit on).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:5">Ib. XXVIII, 5</cite> <cite ref="Nedarim 40b">Ned. 40ᵇ</cite> sq. (ref. to <he>כלי גולה</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 12:3">Ez. XII, 3</cite>) <he>זו נר וקערה וש׳</he> that means a light, a dish, and a mat; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:26">Lam. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>חמת וש׳ וכ׳</he> a leather bag, a mat, and a dish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:3">Ḥull. IX, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 123a:4">123ᵃ</cite>) <he>המפשיט … לש׳</he> (not <he>לשטיחה</he>) he who flays a hide … to be used for a spread; Tosef. ib. VIII, 18 <he>לשָׁטוֹחַ</he>; <cite ref="Chullin 123b">Ḥull. 123ᵇ</cite> <he>לשטוח</he>; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁטִיחִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:10">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:10">V</cite>), 10 <he>ש׳ לבהמה</he> spreads (covers) for beasts.
